reviews.title: Great upgrade and super easy install
reviews.comment:
I purchased this G.SKILL Trident Z RGB 64GB kit as part of a system upgrade and immediately noticed a difference. Installation was very easy. I just had to insert the two sticks into the motherboard, enable XMP in the BIOS, and it worked flawlessly.
The performance difference is also very noticeable, especially in games. I play a lot of World of Warcraft, and the loading times are faster, and everything just seems to run smoother when there’s a lot going on in the game world. I also have a lot of things open while playing games, and it’s nice to have the extra memory make multitasking very easy.
The memory itself is also very attractive. It’s nice and clean in terms of RGB lighting. It also worked very well with the rest of my system lighting. This is a very solid memory kit and exactly what I was hoping for. If you are in the market for a high-capacity memory kit that is very easy to install, then I would definitely suggest this one.
reviews.author: Miles Collins

reviews.title: Amazing RAM & Customer Service
reviews.comment:
I purchased the 64GB (2x32 GB) DDR4 3600 CL 18 about 2-3 weeks ago to upgrade from a set of 32GB (2x16 GB) DDR4 4000 CL 18 and so far, the new RAM has been performing exceptionally.
In my previous configuration, my PC was hitting a bottleneck due to the limited amount of memory available. During gaming sessions, the graphics would stutter and freeze—this went on for a year before I decided enough was enough and pulled the trigger for more RAM. I did some research to see what was on the market before deciding to purchase the G.SKILL Trident Z RGB Series again.
My previous sticks were from the same series but after a year of use, they started to cause my PC to BSOD multiple times. I filed a warranty claim with G.SKILL and completed the RMA request through their exceptional customer service. The memory sticks are covered by a limited lifetime warranty and G.SKILL honored it without asking excessive questions unlike many other companies. The new sticks I received continued to work fine until I decided to upgrade with my current purchase.
So far, I haven't noticed any issues with the new RAM. My games and other daily tasks are operating noticeably smoother with lower latency and the stutters/frame freezes completely disappearing. As far as the RGB goes, I usually keep it white through G.SKILL's lighting control software. The LED's stay reliably lit and I haven't noticed any discoloration over time with any of the RAM from G.SKILL. I've attached some images of how they look within my setup to this review as well.
Considering the amount of frustration I felt before, I can say with confidence that this RAM was money well spent.
reviews.author: DJ

reviews.title: Outstanding Performance and Stunning RGB: G.SKILL Trident Z RGB 256GB DDR4 Review
reviews.comment:
I recently upgraded my PC with the G.SKILL Trident Z RGB Series (Intel XMP) DDR4 RAM, 256GB (8x32GB) kit, and I'm thoroughly impressed. This memory set is a game-changer for anyone needing top-tier performance and aesthetics in their build.
#### Performance
With a speed of 3600MT/s and a CL18-22-22-42 latency, this RAM offers blazing fast performance. It handles intensive multitasking and demanding applications with ease. Whether I'm rendering videos, running virtual machines, or gaming, the performance boost is noticeable. The Intel XMP profile simplifies overclocking, ensuring I get the best speed without hassle.
#### Capacity
The 256GB capacity (8x32GB modules) is phenomenal. It provides more than enough room for all my projects, making it perfect for content creators or anyone who requires extensive memory for large workloads. This kit future-proofs my system for years to come.
#### Design and RGB Lighting
The design of the Trident Z series is sleek and modern. The RGB lighting is customizable, allowing for a stunning display that matches my build’s theme. The integration with popular motherboard RGB software makes synchronization easy, providing a visually appealing setup.
#### Compatibility
I had no issues installing these modules on my Intel-based motherboard. They fit perfectly and worked right out of the box. The compatibility with Intel XMP profiles made setup straightforward, maximizing performance without manual tuning.
#### Conclusion
Overall, the G.SKILL Trident Z RGB 256GB DDR4 kit offers an unbeatable combination of performance, capacity, and style. It’s perfect for gamers, content creators, and power users looking for reliable, high-performance RAM. Highly recommended for anyone seeking to enhance their system with both speed and aesthetics.
